  AUTHOR:        LUMINA AI CLOUD SWARM - PRINCIPAL AUTOMATION FELLOW & CPS CHAIR (V7 MAX)
  OPERATING TEMP: 650.0 DEG C (NOMINAL CORE) | PERMISSIBLE OPERATING WINDOW: 620.0 - 675.0 DEG C
  ELECTROLYTE:   MOLTEN EUTECTIC (Li0.62 K0.38)2CO3 IN SUBMICRON POROUS gamma-LiAlO2 CERAMIC MATRIX
  STACK RATING:  4 STRINGS x 400 PLANAR CELLS (1,600 CELLS TOTAL) | ACTIVE AREA: 10,000 cm2/cell
  DESIGN LIFE:   40,000 TO 80,000 OPERATING HOURS CONTINUOUS UNATTENDED BASELOAD SEQUESTRATION

  CORE PROCESS ARCHITECTURE & MULTI-PHYSICS GOVERNING PRINCIPLES:

  1. DYNAMIC ELECTROCHEMICAL CO2 PUMPING & CATHODE TRANSFER FLUX:
     Unlike amine absorption stripping columns that consume 2.5 - 4.0 MJ/kg of thermal energy,
     the MCFC acts as an active electrochemical CO2 concentrator while generating net electricity.
     Point-source flue gas (4.0% to 14.5% CO2, 10.0% to 15.0% O2) from upstream industrial emitters
     (gas turbines, cement kilns, steel mills) is routed to the porous lithiated nickel oxide cathode.
     Cathode Half-Cell Reaction:
         CO2(g) + 0.5 O2(g) + 2e- ---> CO3^2-(melt)
     Under the electric field established across the 1.0 mm molten carbonate electrolyte tile,
     carbonate anions (CO3^2-) migrate across the submicron pores to the porous Ni-Cr/Ni-Al anode.
     Anode Half-Cell Reactions:
         H2(g) + CO3^2-(melt)  ---> H2O(g) + CO2(g) + 2e-
         CO(g) + CO3^2-(melt)  ---> 2 CO2(g) + 2e-
     Faradaic Pumping Flux:
         N_CO2 [mol/(m2*s)] = i_cell / (2 * F) * eta_Faradaic
         where F = 96485.332 C/mol and eta_Faradaic = 0.985 (98.5% selectivity).
     Each Faraday equivalent transferred simultaneously pumps CO2 against its concentration
     gradient and delivers DC electrical work. The anode exhaust emerges rich in CO2 and H2O.
     Upon simple moisture condensation, a >95 mol% pure CO2 stream is recovered for sequestration.

  2. IN-SITU INTERNAL METHANE STEAM REFORMING (DIR) & SYNGAS HEAT INTEGRATION:
     Direct Internal Reforming (DIR) takes place within the anode flow channels across distributed
     Ru/Ni-Al2O3 reforming catalyst pellets directly contacting the hot anode cermet.
     Steam Methane Reforming (SMR, Endothermic):
         CH4 + H2O <===> CO + 3 H2        [Delta H_298 = +206.1 kJ/mol]
     Water-Gas Shift (WGS, Exothermic Equilibrium):
         CO + H2O <===> CO2 + H2          [Delta H_298 = -41.2 kJ/mol]
     Overall Reforming Reaction:
         CH4 + 2 H2O <===> CO2 + 4 H2     [Delta H_298 = +164.9 kJ/mol]
     Syngas Heat Integration:
     Electrochemical oxidation of hydrogen generates substantial Joule heating (I^2 * R) and
     entropic polarization heat: Q_gen = I * (E_th - V_cell).
     In conventional fuel cells, this necessitates massive parasitic air cooling fans. In MCFC,
     the in-situ endothermic SMR reaction absorbs this heat directly at the reaction plane:
         Q_absorbed = r_SMR * Delta H_SMR
     The thermal governor balances fuel feed rate, Steam-to-Carbon ratio (S/C >= 2.2 to prevent
     soot/coking via Boudouard 2CO <-> C + CO2 and methane cracking CH4 <-> C + 2H2), and cathode
     flue gas bypass to hold the core temperature at 650.0 deg C with Delta T_axial < 35 deg C.

  3. CARBONATE ELECTROLYTE LOSS & LONG-TERM DEGRADATION TRACKING:
     At 650 deg C, alkali carbonates exhibit finite vapor pressure through hydrolysis with steam:
         Li2CO3(l) + H2O(g) <===> 2 LiOH(g) + CO2(g)
         K2CO3(l)  + H2O(g) <===> 2 KOH(g)  + CO2(g)
     Over tens of thousands of hours, gaseous alkali hydroxides are stripped away in anode and
     cathode exhaust streams. Concurrently, electrolyte creeps along metallic bipolar plates
     (AISI 310S/316L) to sustain the passivating protective oxide layer (corrosion sink).
     Loss of carbonate empties the fine submicron pore network of the gamma-LiAlO2 matrix,
     increasing matrix electrical resistance and gas cross-over risk.
     The degradation tracker continuously models:
         - Real-time LiOH/KOH equilibrium vapor pressure and convective stripping
         - Bipolar plate corrosion consumption as a function of temperature and operating hours
         - Area Specific Resistance (ASR, Ohm*cm2) escalation
         - Dynamic current density derating ceiling to maintain cell life >= 40,000 hours.

  4. INVERTER GRID POWER SYNCHRONIZATION & POWER CONDITIONING SYSTEM (PCS):
     The MCFC stack DC output (600 - 850 VDC, up to 3,500 A DC) connects to a 4-quadrant
     Active Front End (AFE) Grid-Tied Power Conditioning System (PCS).
     The control block integrates:
         - Fast Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) frequency and phase angle tracking
         - Frequency droop control: P(f) actively supports grid primary frequency stability
         - Reactive power voltage regulation: Q(V) maintains local 11 kV bus stability
         - Low-Voltage Ride-Through (LVRT) and High-Voltage Ride-Through (HVRT) state machines
         - Strict DC current ripple suppression (< 1.5% RMS) to prevent mechanical stress
           on brittle porous ceramic matrices and prevent NiO cathode dissolution.

  5. SAFETY INTERLOCKS & DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE MATRIX INTEGRITY (Delta P_A-C):

     Bubble pressure threshold is approximately 80 - 120 mbar. An instantaneous differential

(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Evaluates critical process safety barriers to protect the fragile ceramic matrix,        *)
(* prevent explosive cross-leakage of hydrogen and oxygen, and isolate electrical faults.   *)

(* Reset Alarm Registers on Positive Transition of Reset Command *)
IF bResetFaults AND (NOT bSystemTripped OR (iState = 0) OR (iState = 100)) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000_0000;
    dwAlarmWord2 := 16#0000_0000;
    dwWarningWord := 16#0000_0000;
END_IF;

(* 1.1 SIL-3 Hardwired Emergency Stop Relay (Active-Low) *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* E-Stop tripped *)
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 1.2 Anode-Cathode Differential Pressure (Delta P_A-C) Catastrophic Hazard *)
(* Nominal Delta P is +30 mbar (anode positive). Bubble pressure of gamma-LiAlO2 matrix is ~80 mbar. *)
(* If Delta P > 45 mbar or Delta P < -10 mbar, immediate risk of seal blowout or oxygen cross-over. *)
IF (rVotedDiffPress_mbar > 45.0) OR (rVotedDiffPress_mbar < -10.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Delta P matrix breach hazard *)
    bMatrixPressureHazard := TRUE;
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
ELSE
    bMatrixPressureHazard := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 1.3 MCFC Stack Core High-High Temperature Trip (> 685 deg C) *)
IF rVotedCoreTemp_DegC > 685.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Core overtemperature sintering hazard *)
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 1.4 MCFC Stack Core Low Temperature Trip while Loaded (< 590 deg C) *)
(* Solidification of eutectic carbonate (m.p. ~490-520C) under electrical load destroys tiles *)
IF (rVotedCoreTemp_DegC < 590.0) AND (iState >= 60) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Eutectic freezing under load hazard *)
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 1.5 Stack Terminal DC Overvoltage Trip (> 920 VDC) *)
IF rVotedStackVoltage_V > 920.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* DC bus overvoltage trip *)
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 1.6 Single Cell Severe Undervoltage / Fuel Starvation (< 0.55 V/cell) *)
IF (rSingleCellVoltage_V < 0.55) AND (iState >= 60) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Cell voltage collapse / starvation *)
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 1.7 Steam-to-Carbon Ratio Critical Coking Interlock (S/C < 2.0) *)
IF (rActualSteamCarbonRatio < 2.00) AND (rAnodeMethaneFlow_Nm3h > 10.0) AND (iState >= 40) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Severe coking / carbon deposition *)
    bCokingHazardAlarm := TRUE;
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
ELSE
    bCokingHazardAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 1.8 Utility Grid Severe Voltage/Frequency Loss-of-Mains (Anti-Islanding) *)
IF ((rVotedGridVoltage_V < 280.0) OR (rVotedGridVoltage_V > 460.0) OR
    (rVotedGridFreq_Hz < 47.0) OR (rVotedGridFreq_Hz > 53.0)) AND (iState >= 60) AND NOT bLvrtActive THEN
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Grid out of bounds / islanding trip *)
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Master Failsafe Trip Execution *)
IF bSystemTripped THEN
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bGridSynchronized := FALSE;
    iState := 100; (* Direct transition to emergency nitrogen quench & trip *)
END_IF;

    ELSIF NOT bGridVolt_Ch2_Fault THEN rVotedGridVoltage_V := rGridVoltage_V_Ch2;
    ELSE rVotedGridVoltage_V := rGridVoltage_V_Ch3;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0020;
END_IF;

(* 2.7 Utility Grid Frequency 2oo3 Voting (Tolerance: 0.15 Hz) *)
bGridFreq_Dev_1_2 := ABS(rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch1 - rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch2) > 0.15;
bGridFreq_Dev_2_3 := ABS(rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch2 - rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch3) > 0.15;
bGridFreq_Dev_1_3 := ABS(rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch1 - rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch3) > 0.15;

IF bGridFreq_Dev_1_2 AND bGridFreq_Dev_1_3 THEN bGridFreq_Ch1_Fault := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bGridFreq_Dev_1_2 AND bGridFreq_Dev_2_3 THEN bGridFreq_Ch2_Fault := TRUE; END_IF;
IF bGridFreq_Dev_1_3 AND bGridFreq_Dev_2_3 THEN bGridFreq_Ch3_Fault := TRUE; END_IF;
bGridFreq_Degraded_1oo2 := bGridFreq_Ch1_Fault OR bGridFreq_Ch2_Fault OR bGridFreq_Ch3_Fault;

IF NOT bGridFreq_Degraded_1oo2 THEN
    IF (rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch1 >= rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch2 AND rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch1 <= rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch3) OR
       (rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch1 <= rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch2 AND rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch1 >= rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch3) THEN
        rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch1;
    ELSIF (rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch2 >= rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch1 AND rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch2 <= rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch3) OR
          (rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch2 <= rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch1 AND rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch2 >= rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch3) THEN
        rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch2;
    ELSE
        rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch3;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bGridFreq_Ch1_Fault AND NOT bGridFreq_Ch2_Fault AND NOT bGridFreq_Ch3_Fault THEN
    rVotedGridFreq_Hz := (rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch2 + rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch3) * 0.5;
ELSE
    IF NOT bGridFreq_Ch1_Fault THEN rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch1;
    ELSIF NOT bGridFreq_Ch2_Fault THEN rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch2;
    ELSE rVotedGridFreq_Hz := rGridFrequency_Hz_Ch3;
    END_IF;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0040;
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 ELECTROCHEMICAL CO2 PUMPING THERMODYNAMICS & DYNAMIC TRANSFER FLUX                    *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Calculates Nernst reversible cell potential, Butler-Volmer activation overpotential,      *)
(* Ohmic matrix resistance, concentration polarization, and Faradaic CO2 transfer flux.      *)

rCoreTemp_Kelvin := rVotedCoreTemp_DegC + 273.15;

(* 3.1 Inlet Gas Molar Rates *)
(* Convert Nm3/h to mol/s using standard molar volume V_m = 22.414 Nm3/kmol *)
IF rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h > 1.0 THEN
    rFlueGasMolarInflow_mols := (rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h * 1000.0) / (rConst_MolarVol_Nm3kmol * 3600.0);
ELSE
    rFlueGasMolarInflow_mols := 0.0;
END_IF;

rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols := rFlueGasMolarInflow_mols * rVotedCathInletCO2_molmol;

(* 3.2 Electrochemical Faradaic CO2 Transfer Rate *)
(* 1 mole of CO2 transferred across carbonate matrix requires 2 Faradays (2 * F = 192,970 C) *)
(* Total transferred across iTotalCellCount cells in series-parallel: *)
rCO2FaradaicTransfer_mols := (rVotedStackCurrent_A * INT_TO_REAL(iCellsPerStack) * INT_TO_REAL(iStackStringCount) * 0.985) /
                             (2.0 * rConst_Faraday_Cmol);

rCO2CapturedFlow_Nm3h := (rCO2FaradaicTransfer_mols * rConst_MolarVol_Nm3kmol * 3600.0) / 1000.0;

(* Instantaneous Capture Efficiency [%] *)
IF rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols > 0.001 THEN
    rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct := (rCO2FaradaicTransfer_mols / rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols) * 100.0;
    IF rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct > 100.0 THEN rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Area-Normalized Cathode CO2 Flux [mol/(m2*s)] *)
rCathodeCO2Flux_molm2s := rCO2FaradaicTransfer_mols / rTotalActiveArea_m2;

(* Cathode Reactant Utilization Fraction [%] *)
IF rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols > 0.001 THEN
    rCathodeUtilization_pct := (rCO2FaradaicTransfer_mols / rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCathodeUtilization_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 3.3 Thermodynamic Reversible Nernst Potential Calculation *)
(* E_0(T) = 1.2723 - 0.000276 * (T - 273.15) [V] *)
rNernstPotential_V := 1.2723 - (0.000276 * rVotedCoreTemp_DegC);

(* Real gas partial pressure terms for Nernst equation *)
IF (rCathInletO2_molmol > 0.001) AND (rVotedCathInletCO2_molmol > 0.001) AND
   (rAnodeExhaustH2_molmol > 0.001) AND (rAnodeExhaustCO2_molmol > 0.001) THEN
    (* Nernst equilibrium correction: (R*T)/(2*F) * ln( (P_H2 * P_O2^0.5 * P_CO2_cath) / (P_H2O * P_CO2_anode) ) *)
    rNernstPotential_V := rNernstPotential_V +
        ((rConst_GasConst_JmolK * rCoreTemp_Kelvin) / (2.0 * rConst_Faraday_Cmol)) *
        LN( (rAnodeExhaustH2_molmol * SQRT(rCathInletO2_molmol) * rVotedCathInletCO2_molmol) /
            (0.18 * rAnodeExhaustCO2_molmol + 0.0001) );
END_IF;

IF rNernstPotential_V > 1.15 THEN rNernstPotential_V := 1.15; END_IF;
IF rNernstPotential_V < 0.90 THEN rNernstPotential_V := 0.90; END_IF;

rOpenCircuitVoltage_V := rNernstPotential_V * INT_TO_REAL(iCellsPerStack);

(* 3.4 Polarization Losses & Cell Terminal Potential *)
rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 := (rVotedStackCurrent_A * 1000.0) / (rCellActiveArea_cm2 * INT_TO_REAL(iStackStringCount));
IF rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 < 0.0 THEN rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Ohmic Loss: i_cell * ASR [V] *)
rOhmicLoss_V := (rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 / 1000.0) * rEstimatedASR_Ohmcm2;

(* Activation Polarization (Symmetric Butler-Volmer approximation: eta_act = 2*R*T/F * asinh(i / (2*i0))) *)
IF rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 > 1.0 THEN
    rActivationLoss_V := 0.048 * LN(1.0 + (rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 / 12.0));
ELSE
    rActivationLoss_V := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Concentration Polarization (Mass transport boundary layer limitation) *)
IF rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 > 150.0 THEN
    rConcentrationLoss_V := 0.032 * LN(1.0 / (1.001 - (rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2 / 240.0)));
ELSE
    rConcentrationLoss_V := 0.00015 * rCurrentDensityDemand_mAcm2;
END_IF;
IF rConcentrationLoss_V > 0.18 THEN rConcentrationLoss_V := 0.18; END_IF;

(* Net Single Cell Operational Voltage *)
rSingleCellVoltage_V := rNernstPotential_V - rOhmicLoss_V - rActivationLoss_V - rConcentrationLoss_V;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 IN-SITU INTERNAL METHANE STEAM REFORMING (DIR) & SYNGAS HEAT INTEGRATION              *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Models direct internal reforming on nickel anode cermet catalyst, Steam-to-Carbon ratio,  *)
(* endothermic heat absorption, and coupled stack thermal balance.                           *)

(* 4.1 Steam-to-Carbon (S/C) Ratio Monitoring *)
IF rAnodeMethaneFlow_Nm3h > 0.5 THEN
    rActualSteamCarbonRatio := rAnodeSteamFlow_Nm3h / rAnodeMethaneFlow_Nm3h;
ELSE
    rActualSteamCarbonRatio := 3.0; (* Safe default when fuel is isolated *)
END_IF;

IF (rActualSteamCarbonRatio < 2.20) AND (rAnodeMethaneFlow_Nm3h > 2.0) THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Low S/C coking risk warning *)
END_IF;

(* 4.2 Reforming Thermodynamic Equilibrium Constants *)
(* SMR: ln(Kp_SMR) = -26830 / T + 30.114 *)
rEquilConst_SMR := EXP(-26830.0 / rCoreTemp_Kelvin + 30.114);
(* WGS: ln(Kp_WGS) = 4400 / T - 4.036 *)
rEquilConst_WGS := EXP(4400.0 / rCoreTemp_Kelvin - 4.036);

(* 4.3 Methane Reforming Rate (DIR Kinetic Conversion ~88% at 650 deg C) *)
IF rAnodeMethaneFlow_Nm3h > 0.5 THEN
    rMethaneReformingRate_mol_s := ((rAnodeMethaneFlow_Nm3h * 1000.0) / (rConst_MolarVol_Nm3kmol * 3600.0)) * 0.88;
ELSE
    rMethaneReformingRate_mol_s := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Endothermic Reforming Heat Absorption [kW] *)
rReformingHeatAbsorb_kW := (rMethaneReformingRate_mol_s * rConst_DeltaH_SMR_Jmol) / 1000.0;

(* 4.4 Stack Electrochemical Heat Generation [kW] *)
(* Q_gen = I * (V_thermoneutral * N_cells - V_terminal) / 1000.0 *)
rStackInternalHeatGen_kW := (rVotedStackCurrent_A *
                            (rConst_ThermoneutralVolt_V * INT_TO_REAL(iCellsPerStack) - rVotedStackVoltage_V) *
                            INT_TO_REAL(iStackStringCount)) / 1000.0;
IF rStackInternalHeatGen_kW < 0.0 THEN rStackInternalHeatGen_kW := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Net Thermal Surplus Requiring Cathode Flue Gas Cooling [kW] *)
(* Ambient casing convection/radiation loss is approx 18.5 kW *)
rNetThermalSurplus_kW := rStackInternalHeatGen_kW - rReformingHeatAbsorb_kW - 18.5;

(* 4.5 Axial Thermal Gradient Calculation *)
rAxialThermalGradient_DegC := rStackTempCathExhaust_DegC - rVotedCoreTemp_DegC;
IF ABS(rAxialThermalGradient_DegC) > 35.0 THEN
    bThermalGradientAlarm := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* High thermal stress gradient *)
ELSE
    bThermalGradientAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 4.6 Anode Fuel Utilization Fraction [%] *)
(* 1 mol CH4 yields 4 mol H2 equivalent via SMR+WGS. Total H2 equiv fed = 4 * n_CH4 *)
IF rMethaneReformingRate_mol_s > 0.01 THEN
    rAnodeFuelUtilization_pct := (rCO2FaradaicTransfer_mols / (4.0 * rMethaneReformingRate_mol_s)) * 100.0;
    IF rAnodeFuelUtilization_pct > 100.0 THEN rAnodeFuelUtilization_pct := 100.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rAnodeFuelUtilization_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 MOLTEN CARBONATE ELECTROLYTE LOSS & LONG-TERM DEGRADATION TRACKING                     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Dynamic tracking of alkali hydroxide vaporization (LiOH/KOH), porous matrix depletion,    *)
(* Area Specific Resistance (ASR) growth, and dynamic current density derating limits.       *)

(* 5.1 Lithium Hydroxide Vapor Pressure (Hydrolysis of Li2CO3) *)
(* ln(P_LiOH [bar]) = 12.45 - 18250 / T + 0.5 * ln(P_H2O / P_CO2) *)
rVaporPress_LiOH_bar := EXP(12.45 - (18250.0 / rCoreTemp_Kelvin) +
                            (0.5 * LN( (0.25 * rAnodePress_bar) / (0.70 * rAnodePress_bar + 0.001) )));
IF rVaporPress_LiOH_bar > 0.0005 THEN rVaporPress_LiOH_bar := 0.0005; END_IF;

(* 5.2 Electrolyte Vapor Stripping + Creepage Mass Loss Rate [kg/s] *)
(* Convective mass transfer in exhaust streams + capillary creep onto metallic hardware *)
rElectrolyteLossRate_kgs := (rVaporPress_LiOH_bar * 0.044 * (rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h / 3600.0) * 1.5e-5) +
                            (2.5e-9 * EXP(0.0085 * (rVotedCoreTemp_DegC - 650.0)));

(* Cumulative Integration of Lost Carbonate Mass *)
rCumulativeElectrolyteLoss_kg := rCumulativeElectrolyteLoss_kg + (rElectrolyteLossRate_kgs * rCycleTime_sec);
IF rCumulativeElectrolyteLoss_kg > 200.0 THEN rCumulativeElectrolyteLoss_kg := 200.0; END_IF;

rActiveElectrolyteMass_kg := rInitialElectrolyteMass_kg - rCumulativeElectrolyteLoss_kg;
IF rActiveElectrolyteMass_kg < 100.0 THEN rActiveElectrolyteMass_kg := 100.0; END_IF;

rElectrolyteFraction := rActiveElectrolyteMass_kg / rInitialElectrolyteMass_kg;
rElectrolyteRemaining_pct := rElectrolyteFraction * 100.0;

(* 5.3 Area Specific Resistance (ASR) Degradation Aging Law *)
(* ASR increases with pore emptying (porosity tortuosity escalation) and corrosion oxide scale *)
rAgingFactorASR := (1.0 / (rElectrolyteFraction * SQRT(rElectrolyteFraction))) +
                   (0.0000042 * SQRT(rOperatingHours_h));

rEstimatedASR_Ohmcm2 := rBaselineASR_Ohmcm2 * rAgingFactorASR;

(* 5.4 Dynamic Current Density Derating Ceiling *)
(* As electrolyte inventory depletes, max allowable current is curtailed to prevent matrix drying *)
IF rElectrolyteFraction < 0.85 THEN
    rMaxAllowableCurrentDensity := 180.0 * (rElectrolyteFraction / 0.85);
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0200; (* Electrolyte loss derate active *)
ELSE
    rMaxAllowableCurrentDensity := 180.0;
END_IF;
IF rMaxAllowableCurrentDensity < 75.0 THEN rMaxAllowableCurrentDensity := 75.0; END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 INVERTER GRID POWER SYNCHRONIZATION & POWER CONDITIONING SYSTEM (PCS)                 *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Manages Active Front End (AFE) 4-quadrant inverter phase locking, frequency droop P(f),   *)
(* reactive power voltage regulation Q(V), Low-Voltage Ride-Through (LVRT), and DC ripple.  *)

(* 6.1 Grid Voltage & Frequency Deviation Calculations *)
rGridVoltDeviation_V := rVotedGridVoltage_V - 400.0;
rGridFreqDeviation_Hz := rVotedGridFreq_Hz - 50.00;

(* 6.2 Primary Frequency Droop Active Power Adjustment P(f) *)
(* Grid code droop standard: 4% droop corresponds to 120 kW per Hz on a 2.5 MW plant *)
IF ABS(rGridFreqDeviation_Hz) > 0.05 THEN
    rDroopActivePower_kW := -120.0 * (rGridFreqDeviation_Hz - (0.05 * (rGridFreqDeviation_Hz / ABS(rGridFreqDeviation_Hz))));
ELSE
    rDroopActivePower_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 6.3 Reactive Power Voltage Support Q(V) *)
(* Grid voltage regulation: inject reactive power if voltage drops, absorb if voltage surges *)
IF ABS(rGridVoltDeviation_V) > 8.0 THEN
    rDroopReactivePower_kVAR := -12.5 * (rGridVoltDeviation_V - (8.0 * (rGridVoltDeviation_V / ABS(rGridVoltDeviation_V))));
ELSE
    rDroopReactivePower_kVAR := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rDroopReactivePower_kVAR > 600.0 THEN rDroopReactivePower_kVAR := 600.0; END_IF;
IF rDroopReactivePower_kVAR < -600.0 THEN rDroopReactivePower_kVAR := -600.0; END_IF;
rInverterReactiveSetpoint_kVAR := rDroopReactivePower_kVAR;

(* 6.4 Low-Voltage Ride-Through (LVRT) State Machine *)
(* If utility grid drops below 0.90 pu (360 V), stay connected and provide reactive current *)
IF (rVotedGridVoltage_V < 360.0) AND (iState >= 60) AND NOT bSystemTripped THEN
    bLvrtActive := TRUE;
    rLvrtTimer_sec := rLvrtTimer_sec + rCycleTime_sec;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0400; (* LVRT ride-through active *)
    (* In LVRT, freeze active power ramping and prioritize reactive support *)
    rInverterPowerInternal_kW := rInverterExportPower_kW * (rVotedGridVoltage_V / 400.0);
    rInverterReactiveSetpoint_kVAR := 600.0; (* Maximum reactive voltage support injection *)
    (* Disconnect if grid does not recover within 2.0 seconds or collapses below 0.25 pu (100 V) *)
    IF (rLvrtTimer_sec > 2.0) OR (rVotedGridVoltage_V < 100.0) THEN
        dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* LVRT timeout / severe grid collapse *)
        bSystemTripped := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bLvrtActive := FALSE;
    rLvrtTimer_sec := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* 6.5 Stack DC Bus Power & Inverter Active Export Power Calculation *)
(* Gross DC power generated by all stack strings: *)
rInverterDCLinkPower_kW := (rVotedStackVoltage_V * rVotedStackCurrent_A * INT_TO_REAL(iStackStringCount)) / 1000.0;

(* Net active AC power export setpoint (accounting for 96.8% inverter efficiency and plant aux) *)
IF (iState >= 60) AND NOT bLvrtActive THEN
    rInverterPowerInternal_kW := (rInverterDCLinkPower_kW * 0.968) - 85.0 + rDroopActivePower_kW;
    IF rInverterPowerInternal_kW < 0.0 THEN rInverterPowerInternal_kW := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF rInverterPowerInternal_kW > rTargetGridPower_kW THEN rInverterPowerInternal_kW := rTargetGridPower_kW; END_IF;
    IF rInverterPowerInternal_kW > 2800.0 THEN rInverterPowerInternal_kW := 2800.0; END_IF;
ELSIF NOT bLvrtActive THEN
    rInverterPowerInternal_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;
rInverterPowerSetpoint_kW := rInverterPowerInternal_kW;

(* 6.6 Stack DC Current Ripple Diagnostics *)
(* High 100 Hz / 300 Hz inverter PWM ripple damages porous matrix and accelerates Ni dissolution *)
IF rStackCurrentRipple_pct > 1.80 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0800; (* High DC current ripple alert *)
END_IF;


(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 6-STATE MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE DISCRETE MODEL & REAL-TIME MPC OPTIMIZATION         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Executes 10-step prediction horizon discrete state-space model and projected gradient     *)
(* descent quadratic programming to simultaneously regulate core temperature, CO2 pumping,   *)
(* methane conversion, differential pressure, DC voltage, and electrolyte preservation.      *)

(* States: x1=Tcore [C], x2=N_CO2 [mol/m2s], x3=X_CH4 [-], x4=DeltaP_AC [mbar], x5=V_DC [V], x6=theta_elect [-] *)
aMatrix_A[1,1] := 0.9982;  aMatrix_A[1,2] := 0.0125;  aMatrix_A[1,3] := -0.0450; aMatrix_A[1,4] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[1,5] := 0.0018;  aMatrix_A[1,6] := 0.0005;

aMatrix_A[3,1] := 0.0008;  aMatrix_A[3,2] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[3,3] := 0.9720;  aMatrix_A[3,4] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[3,5] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[3,6] := 0.0000;

aMatrix_A[5,1] := 0.0150;  aMatrix_A[5,2] := -0.0520; aMatrix_A[5,3] := 0.0240;  aMatrix_A[5,4] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_A[5,5] := 0.9910;  aMatrix_A[5,6] := 0.0450;

(* 7.2 Populate Discrete Input Matrix B *)
(* Inputs: u1=I_demand [A], u2=u_damper [%], u3=u_CH4_vlv [%], u4=P_inv_sp [kW] *)
aMatrix_B[1,1] := 0.0085;  aMatrix_B[1,2] := -0.0650; aMatrix_B[1,3] := -0.0420; aMatrix_B[1,4] := 0.0000;
aMatrix_B[2,1] := 0.000062; aMatrix_B[2,2] := 0.0000; aMatrix_B[2,3] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_B[2,4] := 0.0000;
aMatrix_B[3,1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_B[3,2] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_B[3,3] := 0.0035;  aMatrix_B[3,4] := 0.0000;
aMatrix_B[4,1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_B[4,2] := -0.0080; aMatrix_B[4,3] := 0.0120;  aMatrix_B[4,4] := 0.0000;
aMatrix_B[5,1] := -0.0480; aMatrix_B[5,2] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_B[5,3] := 0.0180;  aMatrix_B[5,4] := -0.0120;
aMatrix_B[6,1] := -0.0000002; aMatrix_B[6,2] := 0.0000; aMatrix_B[6,3] := 0.0000; aMatrix_B[6,4] := 0.0000;

(* 7.3 Populate Disturbance Matrix E *)
(* Disturbances: w1=y_CO2_inlet [mol/mol], w2=V_flue [Nm3/h] *)
aMatrix_E[1,1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_E[1,2] := -0.0015;
aMatrix_E[2,1] := 0.0450;  aMatrix_E[2,2] := 0.00002;
aMatrix_E[3,1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_E[3,2] := 0.0000;
aMatrix_E[4,1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_E[4,2] := -0.0008;

aMatrix_E[6,1] := 0.0000;  aMatrix_E[6,2] := -0.0000001;

(* 7.4 Load Current States, Setpoints & Disturbance Measurements *)
aState_x[1] := rVotedCoreTemp_DegC;
aState_x[2] := rCathodeCO2Flux_molm2s;
aState_x[3] := rMethaneReformingRate_mol_s / (rFlueGasMolarInflow_mols + 0.001);
aState_x[4] := rVotedDiffPress_mbar;
aState_x[5] := rVotedStackVoltage_V;
aState_x[6] := rElectrolyteFraction;

aSetpoint_y_ref[1] := 650.0;                       (* Target Core Temp 650 deg C *)
aSetpoint_y_ref[2] := (rCathodeCO2MolarInflow_mols * (rTargetCO2CaptureEff_pct / 100.0)) / rTotalActiveArea_m2;
aSetpoint_y_ref[3] := 0.88;                        (* Optimal DIR conversion *)
aSetpoint_y_ref[4] := 30.0;                        (* Target Anode-Cathode Delta P [mbar] *)
aSetpoint_y_ref[5] := 720.0;                       (* Nominal Stack DC terminal voltage [V] *)
aSetpoint_y_ref[6] := 1.00;                        (* Ideal electrolyte inventory *)

aDisturbance_w[1] := rVotedCathInletCO2_molmol;
aDisturbance_w[2] := rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h;

(* 7.5 MPC Quadratic Cost Weighting Matrices (Q, R, S) *)
aWeight_Q[1] := 2.50;   (* Weight on Core Temperature error *)
aWeight_Q[2] := 85.0;   (* Weight on CO2 Capture flux tracking *)
aWeight_Q[3] := 15.0;   (* Weight on Methane reforming conversion *)
aWeight_Q[4] := 120.0;  (* Heavy penalty on Delta P deviation *)
aWeight_Q[5] := 1.20;   (* Weight on DC bus voltage error *)

aWeight_R[1] := 0.025;  (* Slew rate penalty on current demand *)
aWeight_R[2] := 0.150;  (* Slew penalty on bypass damper *)
aWeight_R[3] := 0.200;  (* Slew penalty on methane fuel valve *)

(* 7.6 Real-Time Projected Gradient Descent Quadratic Programming Solver *)
(* Evaluates the local gradient of J with respect to control inputs u_1..4 *)

              (aWeight_Q[2] * aMatrix_B[2,1] * (aState_x[2] - aSetpoint_y_ref[2])) +

aGrad_J[2] := (aWeight_Q[1] * aMatrix_B[1,2] * (aState_x[1] - aSetpoint_y_ref[1])) +
              (aWeight_Q[4] * aMatrix_B[4,2] * (aState_x[4] - aSetpoint_y_ref[4])) +
              (aWeight_R[2] * (aControl_u[2] - aControl_u_prev[2]));

aGrad_J[3] := (aWeight_Q[1] * aMatrix_B[1,3] * (aState_x[1] - aSetpoint_y_ref[1])) +
              (aWeight_Q[3] * aMatrix_B[3,3] * (aState_x[3] - aSetpoint_y_ref[3])) +
              (aWeight_Q[4] * aMatrix_B[4,3] * (aState_x[4] - aSetpoint_y_ref[4])) +

aGrad_J[4] := (aWeight_Q[5] * aMatrix_B[5,4] * (aState_x[5] - aSetpoint_y_ref[5])) +
